headline: Bitfinex Intake Falls To 68.2 Million Dollars From 126.4 Million As Binance Rises To 562.3 Million
narrative: Bitfinex clean-asset intake fell to 68.2 million dollars from 126.4 million, while Binance intake rose to 562.3 million dollars from 522.9 million. A positive pipe is dollars arriving on the venue, sell-side supply, and a negative pipe is dollars leaving, measured as the 24-hour change in holdings excluding each exchange's own token. Bitstamp intake stands at 235.8 million dollars and KuCoin intake stands at 30.4 million dollars, while Bybit sent out 26.1 million dollars.
author: jordan
